title: 第72章潭惊凶蟾起 连夜脱危途第71章 溪潭逢凶兽 焰枪定猪亡
lines: 潭惊凶蟾起连夜脱危途（潭惊凶蟾起连夜脱危途（第22页）皮肉剧痛与毒囊破损的刺激下，渊水浊纹蟾彻底被这记风刃激怒。
粗壮后肢猛蹬地面，庞大身躯骤然弓起，低沉沙哑的嘶吼自喉间炸开，周身灰黑毒雾剧烈翻涌，狂暴戾气隔着雾霭扑面而来。
它头颅猛昂，对准半空的随峰大口怒张，收拢残余毒囊毒素尽数凝于喉间，旋即发动招式——毒口喷浊大片腐蚀性褐黄浊液汹涌喷吐，裹挟浓烈腥毒气息直扑随峰；浊流所过之处草木瞬间焦枯碳化，空气被蚀得滋滋作响，腥臭毒幕横向铺展，封死大半闪避空间。
随峰目光一凛，望见褐黄浊液裹挟毒雾汹涌扑来，双翼猛地振颤，身形急速拔高掠升，轻灵避开横贯而来的毒浊洪流。
腐蚀性浊液擦着下方空域轰落地面，再度腐蚀出一片焦黑狼藉，浓毒雾气在原地翻腾不散，却没能沾到随峰半分羽翼。
浊纹蟾连番攻势落空，见高空随峰灵活难制，当即调转凶戾目光，幽绿瞳仁死死锁定地面的罗止正。
它臃肿身躯猛地弓缩绷紧，后腿全力蹬地如离弦之箭爆射向前，臃肿身躯裹挟毒雾迅猛突进，坚硬头颅狠狠撞出。
这正是爆冲头锤。
带着厚重惯性与毒雾戾气的庞大身躯直扑而来，坚硬颅甲裹挟千钧力道，直指罗止正胸腹要害，势要将他狠狠撞飞。
罗止正眼看浊纹蟾挟凶狂冲势直奔自己撞来，眸光骤然一凛，当即沉腰扎步，双手紧握岩纹寒铁枪横挡于身前。
双手佩戴的烈焰分指拳套倏然迸出刺目火光，磅礴火灵力自拳套奔涌灌入枪身，顺着枪杆极速攀延流转，瞬息之间，整柄长枪被翻涌灼焰彻底裹覆，烈烈生威。
他沉肩绷臂，以双臂之力稳稳架住枪身，严阵格挡。
砰——震耳轰鸣炸响整片溪谷！
毒蟾坚硬颅甲悍然撞上燃火枪身，烈焰与毒雾疯狂对冲，四溅火星混着腐蚀性毒沫漫天飞散。
巨力汹涌压来，罗止正脚步不由自主连连倒退数尺，靴底在石滩上刮出两道深痕，身躯被冲势持续向后拖拽，格挡防线步步承压、濒临崩碎。
下一刻，蛮横力道骤然爆发，他再也撑持不住，整个人被狠狠爆射凌空倒飞数丈之远。
身躯划过一道沉重弧线，后背重重砸嵌在后方粗壮古木之上！
剧烈震击传遍整株树干，繁密枝叶簌簌狂落漫天纷飞。
身上玄岳镇鳞铠替他硬扛下绝大部分重创钝伤，但如此恐怖冲击力依旧超出铠体承受极限，后背肩胛受力位置瞬间崩裂出数道交错狰狞裂痕，甲片错位绷开。
残余狂暴力道透铠入体，脏腑翻涌剧痛难忍，喉头腥甜翻涌，一口热血呕落胸前，岩纹寒铁枪脱手坠地，他顺着树干缓缓滑坐，气息紊乱急促。
李紫云瞳孔骤缩，望见这一幕心头骤紧，当即扬声急喝：“止正！”
话音未落，她左手高擎灵角寒霜弓，弓身凌空一震，刺骨寒气自弓纹间狂涌而出。
戴着寒冰软皮手套的右手猛地后拉空弦，引动四周寒气疯狂汇聚而来。
弓心之上，寒气骤然凝聚炸裂，三支通体冰晶铸炼、寒光慑人的冰魄箭，在弓弦上凭空凝实成形，箭尖寒芒暴涨数尺，冻得空气层层扭曲。
她弓开如满月，腕间灵力轰然迸发。
“冰魄箭！”
三道冰蓝色箭矢齐射而出，如三道寒芒破空，去势疾如流星，所过之处空气凝结成细密冰屑，拖出三道晶莹冷冽的光痕。
箭矢转瞬即至，一支直射浊纹蟾头颅，一支射向腹部，另一支狠狠钉入粗壮前腿之上，刹那间寒气炸开，冰层顺着三处伤口疯狂蔓延，白霜以肉眼可见速度爬满蟾身，将它前半身层层冰封裹牢，臃肿身躯顿时僵在原地，冲势戛然而止。
趁浊纹蟾被寒冰死死禁锢的短暂空档，李紫云不敢耽搁分毫，身形骤然提速，足尖点地快步疾冲，瞬息掠至罗止正身前。
她望着他苍白的面色，眉眼间满是焦灼，轻声急问：“你怎么样？伤得重不重？”
罗止正抬手擦去唇角残留的血痕缓缓抬头，目光落于身前的李紫云，气息虽有些紊乱，眼神却依旧沉稳，低声缓道：“受了点内伤，还死不了。”
话音刚落，他俯身伸手捡起滚落一旁的岩纹寒铁枪，稳稳攥住枪杆，目光凝重望向被冰封的浊纹蟾，语速急促，带着不容置疑的决断：“我们与它境界相差太远，不要跟它死斗，赶紧撤！”
就在二人对话的短短片刻，被冰封的浊纹蟾皮下不断渗出腐蚀性黑浊毒液，毒液所过之处，坚冰滋滋冒起白雾，以肉眼可见速度消融开裂。
先是表层冰层崩落碎块，随即前半身冰封层迅速消融殆尽，腥臭毒雾再度弥漫开来，它猛地仰头发出一声震耳的怒啸，臃肿身躯重新弓起，凶戾目光死死锁定二人，腥臭涎水顺着獠牙滴落地面，石滩被蚀出点点凹痕。
脱困的浊纹蟾凶性彻底暴涨，丝毫没有半分停顿，粗壮后腿猛然蹬地发力，沉重臃肿的身躯裹挟着漫天腥臭毒雾，再度施展出爆冲头锤！
轰隆一声闷响，地面碎石四溅、尘土翻涌，它如同离弦之箭般爆射而出，坚硬布满疙瘩的蟾首在前，锁定罗止正与李紫云，携着无匹的冲撞之力狂暴猛冲而来！
狂风被身躯强行撕裂，扑面的腥臭劲风压迫得人呼吸一滞，那沉甸甸的冲撞威势较之方才更显狂暴凌厉，显然破冰之后，它已然动了必杀之心。
李紫云眼底骤然凝起凛凛寒色，见浊纹蟾再度悍然施展爆冲头锤杀来，丝毫不敢懈怠。
她深知这凶兽冲撞之力凶悍绝伦，二人如今处境凶险，绝不能被正面命中。
她左手紧握着灵角寒霜弓稳住身形，周身冰灵力如潮水般涌向右手。
只见她右臂微沉，戴着寒冰软皮手套的手掌寒气如渊似狱，冰冷威压瞬间笼罩整片战场。
紧跟着，她单膝跪地，右手狠狠压在地面。
“玄冰锁天牢！”
寒气顺着掌心轰然破土，无数尖锐冰棱自地底疯狂窜出，纵横交错、层层堆叠，瞬间编织成一座密不透风的巨大冰封囚笼。

The Tanjing Ferocious Toad set out on its journey to escape danger overnight (Page 22) Stimulated by the severe pain in its skin and flesh and the damage of its poison sac, the Yuanshui Turbid Pattern Toad was completely angered by the wind blade.
The thick hind limbs kicked the ground violently, the huge body suddenly arched, a low and hoarse roar exploded from the throat, the gray and black poisonous mist surged violently around the body, and the violent and violent air rushed towards the face through the mist.
It raised its head fiercely, aimed at Suifeng in mid-air, opened its mouth angrily, collected the remaining poison sacs, and condensed all the toxins in its throat, and immediately launched a move - the poisonous mouth spat out a large corrosive brown liquid, carrying a strong smell of poison directly towards Suifeng; the vegetation where the turbid flow passed was instantly withered and carbonized, and the air was corroded to make a sizzling sound. The stench of poisonous curtain spread horizontally, sealing most of the dodging space.
With a sharp look, Sui Feng saw the brownish-yellow turbid liquid carrying poisonous mist rushing towards him. His wings trembled violently, and his body quickly rose up, avoiding the torrent of poisonous turbidity that came across.
The corrosive turbid liquid wiped the airspace below and crashed to the ground, corroding into a charred black mess again. The thick poisonous mist continued to billow in place, but it failed to touch Sui Feng's wings.
The Turbid Toad's successive attacks failed. Seeing that it was difficult to control the agility of Sui Feng at high altitude, he immediately turned his ferocious gaze, and his dark green eyes locked firmly on Luo Zhizheng on the ground.
Its bloated body suddenly flexed and tightened, its hind legs kicked off the ground with all its strength and shot forward like an arrow from the string. Its bloated body was wrapped in poisonous mist and rushed forward quickly, and its hard head was violently knocked out.
This is the explosive hammer.
The huge body with heavy inertia and the vicious aura of poisonous mist rushed straight towards him. The hard skull armor packed a huge force and pointed directly at the vital points of Luo Zhizheng's chest and abdomen, threatening to knock him away.
Luo Zhizheng saw the turbid toad charging straight at him with a fierce momentum. His eyes suddenly froze, and he immediately lowered his waist and stepped forward, holding the rock-patterned cold iron spear in front of him with both hands.
The flame finger gloves worn on both hands suddenly erupted with dazzling flames, and the majestic fire spiritual power poured from the gloves into the gun body, climbing and flowing along the gun shaft at high speed. In an instant, the entire long gun was completely enveloped in the surging flames, and it became fierce and powerful.
He lowered his shoulders and stretched his arms, using the strength of his arms to hold the gun firmly and block it in a strict formation.
Bang - an ear-splitting roar exploded throughout the valley!
The poisonous toad's hard skull slammed into the body of the flaming gun, and the flames and poisonous mist collided crazily, causing sparks and corrosive poisonous foam to fly all over the sky.
Huge force surged forward, and Luo Zhizheng involuntarily stepped back several feet. The soles of his boots scraped two deep scratches on the rocky beach. His body was continuously dragged backward by the momentum, and his blocking defense line was under pressure step by step and was on the verge of collapse.
The next moment, the brute strength suddenly broke out. He could no longer hold on, and his whole body was violently shot and flew several feet into the air.
The body drew a heavy arc, and the back was heavily embedded in the thick ancient tree behind!
The violent shock spread throughout the tree trunk, and the dense branches and leaves rustled wildly and flew all over the sky.
The Xuanyue Suppressing Scale Armor on his body withstood most of the severe and blunt injuries for him, but such a terrifying impact still exceeded the armor's endurance limit. The force-bearing position of the shoulder blades on his back instantly cracked with several staggered and ferocious cracks, and the armor plates were misplaced and stretched open.
The remnants of the violent violence penetrated the body, and his organs surged with excruciating pain. His throat surged with fishy sweetness, and he vomited a mouthful of hot blood onto his chest. The rock-patterned cold iron spear fell from his hand and fell to the ground. He slid slowly along the tree trunk and sat down, his breathing disordered and rapid.
Li Ziyun's pupils shrank suddenly, and when he saw this scene, his heart suddenly tightened, and he immediately raised his voice and shouted: "Stop!"
Before she finished speaking, she held up the Spirit-horned Frost Bow in her left hand. The bow shook in the air, and biting cold air surged out from the bow lines.
The right hand wearing the ice-soft leather glove suddenly pulled back the open string, causing the surrounding cold air to gather crazily.
Above the center of the bow, the cold air suddenly condensed and exploded. Three ice soul arrows, made entirely of ice crystals and filled with stunning cold light, solidified and formed out of thin air on the bowstring. The cold light at the arrow tips soared several feet, causing the air to twist layer by layer.
She opened her bow like a full moon, and spiritual power burst out from her wrists.
"Ice Soul Arrow!"
Three icy blue arrows shot out in a volley, like three rays of cold light piercing the sky, moving as fast as a meteor. The air where they passed condensed into fine ice shavings, dragging out three crystal-clear and cold light traces.
The arrows arrived in a blink of an eye, one shot directly into the head of the Toad, one shot towards the abdomen, and the other was nailed into the thick front legs. In an instant, the cold air exploded, and the ice spread crazily along the three wounds. The hoarfrost climbed all over the toad's body at a speed visible to the naked eye, wrapping its front half in layers of ice. The bloated body suddenly froze in place, and its momentum came to an abrupt end.
Taking advantage of the brief gap when the Turbid Pattern Toad was tightly imprisoned by the ice, Li Ziyun did not dare to delay at all, and his figure suddenly accelerated, sprinting on tiptoes, and instantly rushed in front of Luo Zhizheng.
She looked at his pale face, her brows and eyes full of anxiety, and asked softly and urgently: "How are you? Are you seriously injured?"
Luo Zhizheng raised his hand to wipe away the remaining blood stains on the corners of his lips and slowly raised his head. His eyes fell on Li Ziyun in front of him. Although his breath was a little disordered, his eyes were still calm. He said in a low voice: "I have suffered some internal injuries, but I can't die."
As soon as he finished speaking, he leaned over and reached out to pick up the rock-patterned cold iron spear that rolled to the side. He held the barrel of the gun firmly and looked solemnly at the frozen turbid toad. He spoke quickly and with unquestionable determination: "We are too far away from its realm. Don't fight it to the death, and retreat quickly!"
In the brief moment of the conversation between the two, corrosive black venom continued to leak out from under the skin of the frozen toad. Wherever the venom passed, white mist rose up from the ice, melting and cracking at a speed visible to the naked eye.
First, the surface ice collapsed into pieces, and then the ice on the front half of the body quickly melted away, and the smelly poisonous mist filled the air again. It suddenly raised its head and let out an ear-splitting roar, its bloated body arched again, and its ferocious eyes locked on the two of them. The smelly saliva dripped on the ground along its fangs, and the stone beach was eroded with dents.
The ferocity of the turbid toad that escaped from the trap completely increased, without even a moment's pause, its thick hind legs suddenly kicked the ground with force, its heavy and bloated body was wrapped in the smelly and poisonous mist all over the sky, and it used the explosive hammer again!
With a muffled roar, gravel on the ground splashed and dust surged. It shot out like an arrow from a string, with its hard and knotty toad head in front, locking onto Luo Zhizheng and Li Ziyun, and charging forward violently with unparalleled collision force!
The strong wind was forcibly torn apart from the body, and the smelly wind hitting the face made the person's breath suffocate. The power of the heavy collision was even more violent and fierce than before. It was obvious that after breaking the ice, it had already decided to kill.
Li Ziyun's eyes suddenly turned cold and cold. Seeing the Turbid Pattern Toad brazenly attacking with its explosive head hammer again, he didn't dare to slack off at all.
She knew that the force of the beast's collision was extremely ferocious, and the two of them were in a dangerous situation now, and they must not be hit head-on.
She held the Spirit Horned Frost Bow tightly in her left hand to stabilize her body, and the ice spiritual power around her body surged into her right hand like a tide.
Her right arm sank slightly, and the palm of her hand, which was wearing ice-soft leather gloves, was as cold as an abyss, and the cold pressure instantly enveloped the entire battlefield.
Immediately afterwards, she knelt down on one knee and pressed her right hand hard on the ground.
"Xuan Bing Tian Prison!"
The cold air burst through the ground along the palm of my hand, and countless sharp ice edges burst out from the ground crazily, crisscrossing and stacking up layers, instantly weaving into a huge airtight ice cage.
